comment: Single source of truth for which node commands need native approval before they run. Each key is a command; each value lists the actions that need approval. An empty string stands for a command with no action param (the fs.* writes and the Tier B admin commands). The node decides per call whether a path is protected; an approval marker on an unprotected write is ignored. Read by the Python node tests and the TypeScript plugin tests, which assert their own tables equal this file.
